boundary: These scenarios demonstrate repeatable behavior for the referenced source and fixtures. They are not calibration, IEC 60255 type-test, IEC 61850 conformance, hard-real-time, commissioning, or operational-trip evidence.

scenarios.title: Balanced fundamental RMS and positive sequence
scenarios.input: 80 samples per cycle; balanced 2 A RMS current and 63.5 V RMS voltage at nominal frequency
scenarios.expected: Phase RMS and positive-sequence magnitudes match the synthetic inputs; negative sequence remains near zero

scenarios.title: Normal load remains secure
scenarios.input: Balanced 1 A phase current and 0.02 A residual current under healthy SMV trust
scenarios.expected: No phase or earth pickup and no virtual trip latch

scenarios.title: Phase instantaneous overcurrent operates after definite delay
scenarios.input: Phase A above 50P pickup under healthy SMV trust
scenarios.expected: Phase pickup, configured delay completion, and virtual trip latch

scenarios.title: SMV trust gate blocks trip without hiding pickup
scenarios.input: Phase current above pickup with trip-blocked SMV trust reason SMPCNT_GAP
scenarios.expected: Pickup remains visible, blocked state is asserted, and no new virtual trip is latched

scenarios.title: Undervoltage 27 operates after configured delay
scenarios.input: Balanced 70 V phase-neutral phasors with 90 V pickup and two-of-three logic
scenarios.expected: 27 operates after the configured delay and latches a virtual trip

scenarios.title: Overvoltage 59 operates after configured delay
scenarios.input: Balanced 125 V phase-neutral phasors with 110 V pickup and one-of-three logic
scenarios.expected: 59 operates after the configured delay and latches a virtual trip

scenarios.title: Residual overvoltage 59N operates from 3V0
scenarios.expected: 59N operates from the residual quantity and latches a virtual trip

scenarios.title: 67P forward direction operates
scenarios.input: Positive-sequence current in the configured forward region with adequate V1 polarization
scenarios.expected: 67P directional pickup, delay completion, and virtual trip

scenarios.title: 67P reverse direction restrains
scenarios.input: Positive-sequence current in the reverse region with adequate V1 polarization
scenarios.expected: No directional pickup and no virtual trip

scenarios.title: 67N prefers independent residual channels
scenarios.input: Balanced phase sums with explicit residual-current and residual-voltage channels
scenarios.expected: 67N uses explicit 3I0/3V0 provenance and operates in the selected direction
